scope: October 13, 2025 common rules, Standard Setup, four base factions, Fall/Autumn and Winter, single base Thief/Tinker/Ranger Vagabond, dominance and coalitions.
excluded: Expansion systems, second Vagabond, other characters/maps, hirelings, landmarks, bots and Advanced Setup.
method: Compared complete assigned candidate02 and candidate03 snapshots. Independently checked every revised passage against authoritative Law text and PDF, including direct PDF checks of crafting, special card use, battle prerequisite, piece manipulation, Eyrie Recruit/Turmoil/Evening, supporter capacity/Outrage, Alliance phase order, Quest, Allied cap and Infamy. Unchanged passages retain the previous independent full applicable-source review; source hashes remain identical. No questions, keys, reader responses, grades or other reviews read. No summary edited; previous audits preserved.

checked_claims.details: Each icon needs a matching crafting-piece activation; crafting icons define the cost, with the separately retained item-supply and persistent-effect prerequisites. Vagabond reactivation exception remains correct.
Ambush cannot be crafted and may be used by defender for immediate hits or attacker to foil, matching the clearing. Dominance cannot be crafted but can be activated or spent for suit.
Battle requires an enemy and own warriors/pawn in the clearing; unlike Move, it does not require rule.
When prompted manipulation cannot be completed fully, maximum possible is compulsory; costs/prerequisites are not waived, nor Eyrie full Decree resolution.
One warrior at one roost in a card-matching clearing; Charismatic substitutes two warriors there for one.
Turmoil ends Daylight and begins Evening; normal roost score, draw plus bonuses and discard to five all follow.

Supporter capacity does not cancel required Outrage payment or no-match hand show/draw; the incoming card is discarded if the stack cannot hold it. Dominance still has the separately stated special discard destination.
Birdsong steps are ordered: all desired Revolts, then Spread Sympathy. A token newly placed during that Spread step cannot be used to return to Revolt in the same Birdsong.
Chosen quest must match the Vagabond clearing; item payments/rewards remain unchanged.
Rolled-hit cap with one selected ally equals its warriors in the battle clearing plus total undamaged swords, subject to retained same-ally attack prohibition.

Own-turn battle removal of a Hostile building/token normally earns one ordinary VP plus one Infamy; a Hostile warrior earns one Infamy except the warrior causing hostility. Own turn, rather than attacker status, governs; no Infamy from Strike or another player’s turn.
Edition, component counts and ownership rules; dice face values remain absent.
